entries.heading: APPROPRIATE CONGRESSIONAL COMMITTEES DEFINED
ancestors: TITLE XII—MATTERS RELATING TO FOREIGN NATIONS
Subtitle H—United States Israel Security Assistance
entries.text:
SEC. 1280B. APPROPRIATE 
                            CONGRESSIONAL COMMITTEES DEFINED.

    In this subtitle, the term ``appropriate congressional committees'' 
means--
            (1) the Committee on Foreign Relations and the Committee on 
        Armed Services of the Senate; and
            (2) the Committee on Foreign Affairs and the Committee on 
        Armed Services of the House of Representatives.
